name: signed_snapshot
source:
CONTRACT Demo()
DIM finish = 1
DIM stride = -2
FOR i = 5 TO finish STEP stride
EMIT ASSERT_HEIGHT_ABSOLUTE(i)
finish = 99
stride = 0
NEXT i
END CONTRACT

name: nested_order
source:
CONTRACT Demo()
EMIT ASSERT_HEIGHT_ABSOLUTE(99)
FOR i = 1 TO 2
FOR j = 1 TO i
EMIT ASSERT_HEIGHT_ABSOLUTE(i * 10 + j)
NEXT j
NEXT i
EMIT ASSERT_HEIGHT_ABSOLUTE(100)
END CONTRACT

name: nested_return
source:
FUNCTION Find() AS INTEGER
FOR i = 1 TO 3
IF i = 2 THEN
FOR j = 1 TO 2
RETURN i * 10 + j
NEXT j
ASSERT FALSE
END IF
NEXT i
RETURN 0
END FUNCTION
CONTRACT Demo()
EMIT ASSERT_HEIGHT_ABSOLUTE(Find())
END CONTRACT

name: solution_range
source:
CONTRACT Demo()
SOLUTION finish AS INTEGER
FOR i = 1 TO finish
EMIT ASSERT_HEIGHT_ABSOLUTE(i)
NEXT i
END CONTRACT
